items.title: 7.4.1 Rate law aur rate constant (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4.1, printed page 154.

blocks.title: Rate law
blocks.text: Reactants ki concentrations ke lihaz se reaction ki rate ki numaindagi rate law hai: ek muadla jo rate ko tajurbati data ke mutabiq mukhtalif taqaton (powers) par uthai hui reactants ki concentrations se jorta hai.

Aam reaction aA + bB se cC + dD ke liye rate muadla rate = k [A]^x [B]^y hai, jahan x aur y tajurbe se tai qeematein hain jo balanced muadle ke coefficients a aur b ke barabar ho bhi sakti hain aur nahi bhi. Bracket molar concentrations ke liye hain aur tanasub ka constant k rate constant hai. Agar [A] = 1 mol dm-3 aur [B] = 1 mol dm-3 to rate = k x 1^x x 1^y = k.

blocks.title: Rate constant
blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction ka specific rate constant woh rate hai jab reactants ki concentrations ek (unity) hon. Di gai halaat mein k mustaqil rehta hai, magar darja hararat ke saath badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Reaction A + B se C ke liye rate law rate = k [A][B]^2 hai. Agar ek saath [A] aadhi aur [B] dugni kar di jaye to rate kis guna badalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Rate A ke liye 1/2 se aur B ke liye 2^2 = 4 se zarb hoti hai, to kul 2 se: rate dugni hoti hai. Rate constant k khud nahi badalta, kyunke darja hararat wahi hai.

items: Rate law: rate = k [A]^x [B]^y, x aur y tajurbe se; k woh rate hai jab sab concentrations 1 mol dm-3 hon, kisi darja hararat par mustaqil magar darja hararat ke saath badalta hua.
